clips.title: The story
paras: Embracing the Elements is an introductory shaman quest in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. Initiated by Rorian the Dayseeker, the task directs young practitioners to Windshaper Boro, the local shaman trainer. It introduces the silent rift between the local people and the elemental spirits of the winds.

After helping manage the vuldren pest problem around the village, aspiring shamans are approached by Rorian the Dayseeker. During their time afield, Windshaper Boro left behind a humming recall crystal, signaling that it is time for formal elemental instruction to begin in the center of the grove.

Upon meeting Windshaper Boro, he explains the difficult state of local shamanism. The spirits of the four winds abruptly severed communication years ago, abandoning their former communion. Zephras shamans now dedicate themselves to deep study of the natural world, striving through rigorous training to bridge the silence and coax the spirits into dialogue once more.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Can you hear it? The whispers of the winds? Doubtful, considering that the spirits stopped speaking with us when they left us those years ago.

Those among us who would seek audience with the spirits of the four winds once more hone our understanding of the elements and the natural world, dearly hoping to reestablish the dialogue that was so abruptly ended.
Would you walk this path and master the elements?
Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps and I will train you.
